source.icc_profile: not present on retrieved thumbnail; treated as encoded sRGB for this diagnostic

synthetic_reference.status: constructed cast; not a second photographic capture or physical illuminant ground truth

manual_review.face: polygon follows visible facial skin; eye/brow regions and mouth are excluded; hair and background are excluded by contour
manual_review.arm: polygon follows exposed upper arm; boundary is visible against blouse/background
manual_review.blouse: hand-bounded garment region intersected with fixed source RGB thresholds R>0.48, G>0.45, B>0.38, max-min<0.20 to keep light low-chroma fabric and reject dark print/shadow; pixels overlapping face/arm masks are excluded
limitations: blouse is patterned and shaded, not a calibrated neutral
ROI is analyst-reviewed, not independently annotated
